data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to leave reviews and ratings in Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that helps users leave reviews or open app store pages in the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. It provides a static launch method that can target the current app or any other application via app IDs.
use_when: You want to prompt users to rate or review your app on the App Store or Google Play Store.
You need to direct users to specific app store pages for your own or other applications.
avoid_when: You need state management, network calls, or other unrelated app architecture tools.
strengths: Simple static method API for opening app stores.
Supports specifying custom Android and iOS app IDs.
Allows hiding the write review prompt on iOS to only show the store page.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of Info.plist URL schemes on iOS.
Limited functionality focused entirely on launching store pages and reviews.
data.setup_notes: For iOS 9 and above, you must add LSApplicationQueriesSchemes with itms and itms-beta to your Info.plist file.
